reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /collect draft output with Jacob Kennedy
review: Empty include rather than the proposed eight-type list, which would have dropped the 4 untyped rows, a fifth of a twenty-product shop. The Gift Card the list existed to exclude is refused by _scene.js anyway.
One Booster Pack classifies to tabletop rather than vault and that is right: a booster pack is a card game, not a collectible in a box.
One item is priced at $9,999 and one has no price at all. On a twenty-product shelf both are visible, so worth knowing before somebody reports them as bugs.
